shots.means: runner moving right on the slope, burrbug moving left, both in frame
shots.name: DOWNHILL START
shots.phenomenon: Runner sprints down the curved grass slope; the one enemy walks up the flat to meet them.
shots.setup: burrbug at (1460,1135) walking left; no guardian constructs

shots.means: runner passes over the burrbug with no hit taken
shots.name: ONE ENEMY, ONE LEAP
shots.phenomenon: Runner jumps clean over the burrbug, which skids and turns; the chasm opens ahead.

shots.means: runner airborne past x=1540 over the 940px-deep chasm
shots.move: Pull back to expose deep chasm
shots.name: THE CLIFF
shots.phenomenon: Sprint jump + air jump off the lip toward the high far bank.

shots.means: runner below the far bank top (y>1100), x<2240, falling
shots.name: NOT QUITE!
shots.phenomenon: The jump comes up short: the runner drops below the far lip, reaching for it.

shots.means: runner still airborne inside the left 55% of frame
shots.name: INCOMING CALL
shots.phenomenon: Mid-fall hold. The Discord call card is composited in the edit over the right of frame.

shots.means: guardian aim within 200px of the runner
shots.move: Hero and blue cursor in frame
shots.name: YOUR PARTNER ARRIVES
shots.phenomenon: The guardian's blue YOU pointer slides in beside the falling runner (no second avatar).

shots.means: two guardian platforms exist in the chasm
shots.name: BRIDGE, ON DEMAND
shots.phenomenon: YOU taps a slab under the fall, then draws a rising stroke toward the lip: luminous steps in open air.

shots.means: Events.runner_landed_on_hologram fired
shots.name: JUST IN TIME
shots.phenomenon: The runner lands on the guardian's slab and regains balance.

shots.means: runner on a guardian platform, higher than the first catch
shots.name: KEEP MOVING
shots.phenomenon: Runner climbs the temporary steps toward the lip.

shots.means: runner standing on the far bank (x>2240, feet 1040)
shots.name: SAFE SIDE!
shots.phenomenon: Last hop off the steps onto solid grass, signpost ahead.

shots.means: storm strike 1 telegraphing
shots.name: ELECTRIC BRIDGE
shots.phenomenon: Rain and storm backdrop; the runner steps onto the deck and the first strike is called (spans glow).
shots.setup: checkpoint 1; storm machine idle; rod uncharged

shots.means: deck span 3 non-solid and debris falling
shots.name: A STRIKE!
shots.phenomenon: The bolt lands: flash, shake, span 3 bursts into falling stones in front of the runner.

shots.means: runner standing on a broken high span while spans 7-8 are gone
shots.name: ESCAPE THE GAP
shots.phenomenon: Runner vaults up the broken spans above the double gap; two of them crackle with electricity.
shots.setup: continues; second strike opens a double gap

shots.means: runner in the hall; sandfall and pendulum in frame
shots.name: SHIFTING RUINS
shots.phenomenon: Multi-level ruin: terrace, hall, high ledges, a sand waterfall and the swinging block.

shots.means: block passes within 60px horizontally above the crouching runner, no hit
shots.name: SWINGING MASS
shots.phenomenon: The chained stone block sweeps past just over the crouching runner.

shots.means: collapse state 1 and runner falling below y=1500
shots.name: VERTICAL COLLAPSE
shots.phenomenon: The floor caves in tile by tile; the runner falls down the shaft past sand and falling stones.

shots.means: runner standing on a basalt pillar over the lake
shots.name: VOLCANO CORE
shots.phenomenon: Staggered basalt pillars over the lava lake, hanging chains, a magma slime hopping.

shots.means: sphere rolling within 450px behind the runner
shots.name: HOT PURSUIT
shots.phenomenon: The magma sphere bursts from its tube and rolls down the cracked slope after the runner.

shots.means: runner standing on a swing deck
shots.name: SWING OVER LAVA
shots.phenomenon: Runner leaps onto a chain-hung platform swinging over the lava.
shots.setup: continues; sphere has smashed the crust

shots.means: runner on a rising geyser lift with a lethal jet active nearby
shots.name: BETWEEN THE GEYSERS
shots.phenomenon: An eruption throws the runner's slab up between staggered lava jets.

shots.means: runner on a roof while the train moves >200px/s
shots.name: ROOFTOP TRAIN RUN
shots.phenomenon: Runner runs the roofs of the moving train over the viaduct; mismatched roof heights and cargo.

shots.means: runner airborne between trains, then lands on the lead train
shots.move: Show both car roofs; follow jump
shots.name: TRAIN-TO-TRAIN
shots.phenomenon: Huge leap across the 300-390px gap between the two moving trains.

shots.means: crate landed on the lead train within 300px of the unhurt runner
shots.name: CRANE DROPS
shots.phenomenon: The crane's hook flashes red and drops a crate onto the roof; the runner side-steps and uses it as a step.
shots.setup: continues; crane 2 targets the lead train's middle car

shots.means: runner on the lead train, train moving
shots.name: FULL-SPEED ROOFTOPS
shots.phenomenon: Sprint along the lead train's roofs; aqueduct and meadow rush past.

shots.means: runner inside the hive hall
shots.name: INSIDE THE HIVE
shots.phenomenon: Honeycomb hall: tiered ledges, dripping honey, the paddle wheel and swarm.

shots.means: runner in a honey pool, |vx| <= 130
shots.name: STUCK!
shots.phenomenon: Boots sink into thick honey; the run stalls to a crawl.

shots.means: two or more wax wisps within 320px of the climbing runner
shots.name: SWARM AND PADDLES
shots.phenomenon: Climbing the tiers beside the honey wheel while wax wisps close in.

shots.means: bubble squashed, then runner rising faster than 800px/s
shots.name: BUBBLE SLINGSHOT
shots.phenomenon: The honey bubble bends under the runner, then flings them up.

shots.means: runner rising inside the shaft
shots.name: HIVE SHAFT ASCENT
shots.phenomenon: The honey current carries the launch up the narrow shaft.

shots.means: membrane state 1
shots.name: BREAK THROUGH THE HIVE
shots.phenomenon: The wax membrane bursts; glowing honey debris rains back down the shaft.

shots.means: runner standing on the tilted ledge slope
shots.name: OFF-CENTER LANDING
shots.phenomenon: Drop onto the isolated tilted ledge and recover.

shots.means: giant awake, risen more than half way
shots.name: SOMETHING HUGE WAKES
shots.phenomenon: The stone automaton rises out of the gorge across the route.

shots.means: mace passes beneath the airborne runner with no hit
shots.name: SWEEP!
shots.phenomenon: Jump over the colossal chained mace as it sweeps across the toppled bridge.
shots.setup: continues; slab toppled into a bridge

shots.means: runner on an arched rib bridge
shots.name: THE FOSSIL CANYON
shots.phenomenon: A canyon of enormous fossil ribs; arched rib bridges and rotor skulls.

shots.means: runner on the second rib bridge
shots.name: BONE ARCH RUN
shots.phenomenon: Run up the narrow curved rib high above the canyon.

shots.means: three or more skull drones within 450px
shots.name: ROTORS EVERYWHERE
shots.phenomenon: Rotor-skull drones hover, wind up and lunge between the ribs.

shots.means: beast state 1, deck vertebrae broken
shots.name: IT COMES ALIVE
shots.phenomenon: The skeletal beast erupts through the vertebra bridge below, bursting it apart.

shots.means: jaws chasing, a pillar collapsing and a sand jet active in frame
shots.name: SAND GOES VERTICAL
shots.phenomenon: Sand geysers blast up between collapsing bone pillars as the jaws pursue.

shots.means: jaws snapped at the gate with the runner beyond it
shots.name: CLOSING JAWS
shots.phenomenon: The runner dives through the stone gate; the fossil jaws slam shut behind.

shots.means: runner stays in the lower 45% of frame, moving
shots.name: THE NAME APPEARS
shots.phenomenon: Continuous running down the meadow slope in the lower third; sky left open for the logo.

shots.means: brass drone within 450px while the runner clears the saw
shots.name: CHASE UNDER THE TITLE
shots.phenomenon: Drone pursuers close in as the runner hops the rail saw under the title.

shots.means: runner's floor height changes by 55px+ twice
shots.move: Side follow; camera keeps title centered
shots.name: THE CHASE TIGHTENS
shots.phenomenon: Weaving up and down changing ledge heights past the spike pit and cannon fire.
shots.setup: continues; cannon on the high step

shots.means: runner hurt, then killed by the saw
shots.name: OOPS, DOWN AGAIN
shots.phenomenon: An enemy strike knocks the runner into the saw.
shots.setup: checkpoint 12, beside the post saw; a brass drone swoops from behind

shots.means: runner respawned at checkpoint 12 and moving within 0.5s
shots.name: CHECKPOINT RESTART
shots.phenomenon: Respawn at the checkpoint flag beside the saw; running again at once.

shots.means: two guardian platforms, one slanted >20 degrees
shots.name: WHAT ARE THOSE BLOCKS?
shots.phenomenon: YOU builds blocks in odd places: a steep slanted stroke and a block too high.
shots.setup: continues; guardian builds awkward blocks over the spike bed

shots.means: runner touched a guardian block and reached the meadow at x>26700
shots.name: THAT WAS NOT THE PLAN
shots.phenomenon: The runner scrambles across using the awkward blocks and the pillars, recovering onto the meadow.

shots.means: runner inside the upper 48% of the frame for the whole cut
shots.move: Wide game scene on upper half
shots.name: AVAILABLE IN STORES
shots.phenomenon: Upper half: running and dodging the dipping saw. Lower half left for the store card.
shots.setup: meadow T4; brass drone and dipping saw ahead

shots.means: runner in the upper 48%; a coin collected
shots.name: COMING OCTOBER 2026
shots.phenomenon: Ride the lift and collect the coin line.

shots.means: runner in the upper 48% heading to the goal
shots.name: CREATED BY
shots.phenomenon: Final run over the bridge toward the goal flag.

note: Per-cut checks from a headless run of the final code; stills shot_NN.png from the rendered run (also 49/49).
